messages:
Kai (Partnerships): quick runbook sync for partner marketplace launch. live target Mon 2026-07-20 09:00 PST (embargo). items: partner sandbox link, hero assets, short partner quote, SI quickstart (docker snippet), PR microcopy, and production tracking hooks. who owns what?
June (Marketing): I9ll take PR microcopy + partner social blurbs. will post draft in docs and ping for feedback.
Pri (HW Partner): uploading hero pack (wide + square) to shared drive. sending two logo variants (color + mono). will include preferred attribution.
Faye (Content): drafting blog + 1-liner partner quotes. also drafting a tiny SI quickstart with a Docker run example. need partner headshots and short quotes by Thu EOD.
Amir (Product): landing must include quickstart link and experiment flag for CTA text. DevEx to add events: marketplace_shown, partner_cta_click, si_download. also want to capture sample latency disclaimer area for legal.
Leo (Legal): noted. checklist: exact partner display names from signed agreement, logo usage confirmation, and no performance claims without test ids. legal needs final assets Fri 17:00 PT.
Kai (Partnerships): fallback plan if partner assets late: 1) Redwood hero + partner small badge, 2) use partner quote slot as "partner coming soon" with opt-in mailing list. please add fallback to PR doc.
deploy-bot: staging preview scheduled 2026-07-16T02:30Z -> https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20260716
June (Marketing): PR draft link: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-joint-v1. added fallback language and two CTA options ("Get started" / "Explore integration").
Pri (HW Partner): will confirm headshot + quote by Thu. contact: brandops@partner.co if any swaps.
Faye (Content): SI quickstart snippet (will be hosted as small PDF + gist):
```
# quickstart
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"<key>\" redwood/si-agent:latest \n--connect https://api.redwood.example --partner-id PRI123
```
I'll add a note about rotating keys.
Amir (Product): please add event si_download when PDF clicked. DevEx to QA by Fri 14:00 PT.
Leo (Legal): remind partners their footer logo links must point to partner legal pages per MSA. June pls add link targets in doc.
June (Marketing): done. added link targets and updated distro list for press + partner comms. will request partner quote copy approval in-thread.
Kai (Partnerships): timeline recap: Fri 17:05 June flags PR ready -> Leo legal signoff by 18:00 PT -> Sun dry-run -> Mon prod push (embargo lift 09:00 PST). use this thread for day-of rollcall.
Pri (HW Partner): no blockers. will monitor and ping for last-minute art swaps.
deploy-bot: smoke test: staging preview up; minor mobile hero crop issue at 540px. ticket ENG-11201 created.
Amir (Product): ENG-11201 acknowledged. frontend to deploy fix Thu afternoon.
June (Marketing): will flag here when all assets are green. thanks all. :rocket:
